question: A car driver travels from plane to hill station which are 200 km apart at an average speed of 40 km/h. In the return trip, he covers the same distance at an average speed of 20 km/h. Then, the average speed of the car over the entire distance of 400 km is
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4.**

**Given:** A car driver travels from plane to hill station which are 200 km apart at an average speed of 40 km/h. In the return trip, he covers the same distance at an average speed of 20 km/h.

**Concept Used:** Distance = Speed x Time

**Calculation:**

**⇒ Average speed = dfrac{Total distance}{Total time}**

**⇒ **Total distance = 2 x 200 = 400 km

⇒ Total time from plane to hill and hill to plane = dfrac{200}{40} + dfrac{200}{20} = 15 hours

⇒ Average speed = dfrac{400}{15} = 26.67 km/hr

**Hence, the average speed of the entire distance is 26.67 km/hr.**
